subject: infra.energy
name: Electricity load of data centres and telecom sites
what_would_settle_it: an operator disclosure or a utility connection agreement would settle it; probed 2026-08-05, the Grand-Bassam operator's environmental study discloses installed IT power at design, not measured load; no utility connection agreement published

subject: infra.cybersec
name: National cybercrime report
what_would_settle_it: an agency report for 2025 would settle it; probed 2026-08-05, the 2024 edition is published; no 2025 edition exists on the regulator's own reports page

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Count of services live on the interoperability platform
what_would_settle_it: a ministry progress report against the 100-service target would settle it; probed 2026-08-05, the ministry's clarification note gives contract, phase and target but states no live-service count

subject: gov.protect
name: Regulator annual activity report
what_would_settle_it: publication of the 2024 report would settle it, and is the only route to whether the data-protection function has a separable budget; probed 2026-08-05, the regulator's reports index refused an automated fetch, so publication cannot be ruled out from the site itself; acquisition attempted 2026-08-05 and failed, absence now stated dated on the place hub

subject: gov.standards
name: Migration data governance strategy
what_would_settle_it: a reference number or adoption decree would settle it; probed 2026-08-05, referenced only in passing in reporting; no reference number, adoption decree or text located

subject: gov.protect
name: Regulator position on mobile-money agent identity copies
what_would_settle_it: a regulator communique or decision would settle it; probed 2026-08-05, the question was put to the regulator in July 2026; no communique or decision in reply is published

subject: gov.legislate
name: Any Ivorian artificial-intelligence statute
what_would_settle_it: a published bill, act or implementing decree would settle it; probed 2026-08-05, the national AI strategy itself records the absence of a dedicated legal framework and lists adoption of an AI law as a future action

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: AI strategy financing
what_would_settle_it: an AI budget line, or a disbursement record for the acceleration programme, would settle it; probed 2026-08-05, a government platform reports the PADCI phase 1 ratification decree; the decree text, an AI budget line and any disbursement record are unpublished

subject: finance.budget
name: Published accounts of the universal service fund
what_would_settle_it: the agency publishes no annual report; the settlement law for 2025, due December 2026, would settle the outturn; probed 2026-08-05, ANSUT publishes no annual report or accounts; the state-portfolio directorate's company record and annual portfolio report are the nearest published financials

subject: capacity.training
name: National digital-skills headcount
what_would_settle_it: each programme publishes its own cumulative claim and nothing reconciles them; probed 2026-08-05, the only cumulative national figure is a ministerial statement in media, with no document reconciling it against the separate programme counts
